name: team_planning_rule
description: Get one rule of a scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in, by its name from tenants_planning_rules, as the scenario resolves it: for the whole plan or, with unit_id, at that unit, where the unit and each unit above it beat the plan-wide value, which beats the tenant's default, which beats the rule's own. A unit gone from the scenario takes its rules with it, so it reads the plan-wide value; an id the scenario never held is refused. team_planning_overrides lists which scenario set it. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.
